scope: Read-only review of the native thumb metacarpal fallback, its actual production calibration/runtime formula, numeric evidence, and failure diagnostics before the third startup-only candidate. No production files changed; no redundant grasp suite rerun.

adapter: Export existing findPalmSupport and fitCylinderGrasp without changing palm selection.
Append sixth open-pose candidate only after original five fail.
Apply matching original metacarpal1 rotation in calibration and runtime.
Capture actual weighted displayed hand data on failed calibration.
reviewedDiff.workbench: Only accumulates and displays startup calibration/failure details; inadmissible fit still logs and throws before scene construction.

formulaReview.sameAxis: Original native hand frame.forward; original rig index metacarpal1.L/R.
formulaReview.conclusion: Same algebraic rotation and taper. F fallback changes a native joint rotation only; default compensation is zero for earlier candidates.

numericEvidenceIndependentlyRecomputedFr.calibrationRationale: The recorded -8/-10 degree original-joint measurements extrapolate to approximately -11.56 degrees for a 0.1 mm margin beyond the unchanged open gate. The single rounded -11.6 degree candidate is within the declared 14 degree outward calibration bound.
numericEvidenceIndependentlyRecomputedFr.method: Read actual production fit objects, compare complete A-E objects with baseline, verify source hashes and every stored runtime frame. No new live rendering or independent large numeric run was performed.

failureSafety.fixtureMapping: Original vertex IDs are retained; hand list and palm patch indices are remapped into the copied point set. Existing patch.vertex remains an original ID.
failureSafety.fixtureBoundary: The diagnostic contains weighted points and the selected palm patch, not the complete triangle index buffer. It supports replay of the selected-patch fit, not an independent rerun of palm triangle selection without the original geometry.
failureSafety.exportsBoundary: Helpers remain module exports used by calibration/diagnostics; no production browser control or gate bypass was added.

evidenceLayers.source: Bounded patch and source-contract review supported. Original native mesh, hierarchy and acceptance gates are retained.
evidenceLayers.numeric: Current-source canonical full-CSR hand fixture supports all 12 fits and calibration/runtime parity; A-E ten production fit objects are exactly unchanged.
evidenceLayers.browser: Current candidate complete R07 displayed hand dump, actual startup, six near views and integrated grasp have not been independently verified by this review.
evidenceLayers.public: No R02 public approval or delivery proof supplied by this review.

limits: The hand-only canonical/display equivalence document identifies retained hand vertices and triangle triples through source selectors. It is not a byte-for-byte comparison against a live F full-display hand dump.

A-E equality is established for calibration records and the neutral-rig hand runtime fixture. The new zero metacarpal assignment is not a claim of byte-identical full-body animation frames under every imported base pose.
The finite-cylinder vertex gate is not continuous-triangle nonintersection or force/friction verification.

Production ItemWorld contact, dynamic object lock, lift, bag transfer and actual displayed pickup still need the current candidate integration evidence. The hand calibration does not close the prior pickup fixture/ItemWorld gap.
Earlier a85 pickup and exact long-hair source reviews remain bounded approvals for diagnostic inclusion. They do not approve complete motion, hair collision, clothing or visual quality.
Known clothing/body intersections remain unresolved. No overall candidate or user visual acceptance is granted.
disposition: The F fallback and its fail-closed diagnostics may enter the next startup-only diagnostic with releaseCandidate=false. Require actual current-head rendered evidence before any broader acceptance.
